candidates.source_title: Denzel Washington Took A REAL Whip Strike #history #ww2
candidates.source_description:
While filming Glory in 1989, Denzel Washington played Private Trip in the film’s famous whipping scene. The whip wasn't a real leather whip—director Edward Zwick later explained that it was a piece of chamois/shammy cloth attached to a stick. But it still stung when it struck Washington.
Zwick felt the scene could go further, so for another take he told the actor playing the soldier with the whip not to stop until he called “cut.” Washington was caught off guard by how long the flogging continue
